## What this changes

A short description of the change and why.

## For content changes

- [ ] Questions are original and test a concept (no copied or memorized exam items).
- [ ] Every AWS fact is backed by a link to current AWS documentation.
- [ ] Each new question has an explanation and at least one reference link.
- [ ] Lessons changed here have their `updated` date set to the verification date.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (type-check, content validation, and the build).
- [ ] The change is focused and does not bundle unrelated edits.
- [ ] Commit messages are brief, lowercase, and imperative.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full rules.
